refrigerator.definition: An appliance that keeps food cold without normally freezing it.
refrigerator.exampleUsage: The vegetables are in the refrigerator.

stove.definition: An appliance with cooking burners or heating surfaces.
stove.exampleUsage: Soup is cooking on the stove.

oven.definition: An enclosed appliance or compartment for baking or heating food.
oven.exampleUsage: The bread is warming in the oven.

microwave.definition: An appliance that heats food using microwaves.
microwave.exampleUsage: The microwave is on the counter.

dishwasher.exampleUsage: The plates are in the dishwasher.

toaster.definition: An appliance for browning slices of bread.

blender.definition: An appliance for mixing or puréeing food.

kettle.definition: A container or appliance used to heat water.
kettle.exampleUsage: The kettle is on the counter.

coffee-maker.definition: A device used to prepare coffee.
coffee-maker.exampleUsage: The coffee maker is beside the kettle.

freezer.definition: An appliance or compartment that keeps food frozen.
freezer.exampleUsage: The frozen food is in the freezer.

pot.definition: A cooking container, usually deep and with handles.

pan.definition: A cooking container; its shape depends on its use.
pan.exampleUsage: Rana chooses a pan for the meal.

frying-pan.definition: A shallow pan with a handle used for frying.
frying-pan.exampleUsage: The frying pan is on the stove.

baking-tray.definition: A flat tray used for baking food in an oven.
baking-tray.exampleUsage: Bread rolls are on the baking tray.

saucepan.definition: A deep cooking pan, usually with one long handle.

wok.definition: A deep rounded pan often used for stir-frying.
wok.exampleUsage: Chen cooks vegetables in a wok.

casserole-dish.definition: An ovenproof dish for cooking and serving a casserole.
casserole-dish.exampleUsage: The casserole dish has a lid.

baking-dish.definition: An ovenproof dish used for baking food.
baking-dish.exampleUsage: The baking dish is on the counter.

steamer.definition: A device or pan used to cook food with steam.
steamer.exampleUsage: The steamer is stored in the cupboard.

pressure-cooker.definition: A sealed cooking pot that cooks under raised pressure.
pressure-cooker.exampleUsage: The pressure cooker is closed and not in use.

fork.exampleUsage: The fork is beside the plate.

knife.definition: A tool with a blade for cutting.
knife.exampleUsage: The knife is stored in its sheath.

spoon.definition: A utensil with a shallow bowl on a handle.
spoon.exampleUsage: The spoon is beside the bowl.

spatula.definition: A flat kitchen tool used to turn, lift or spread food.
spatula.exampleUsage: The spatula is beside the pan.

ladle.definition: A spoon with a deep bowl used for serving liquids.

whisk.definition: A tool used to beat or mix ingredients.
whisk.exampleUsage: The whisk is beside the mixing bowl.

tongs.definition: A tool with two arms used to grip and lift food.
tongs.exampleUsage: The tongs are on the tray.

peeler.definition: A tool used to remove the skin of vegetables or fruit.
peeler.exampleUsage: The peeler is beside the carrots.

grater.definition: A tool with sharp-edged holes used to shred food.
grater.exampleUsage: The grater is beside the cheese.

rolling-pin.definition: A cylinder used to flatten dough.
rolling-pin.exampleUsage: The rolling pin is beside the dough.

can-opener.definition: A tool for opening metal food cans.
can-opener.exampleUsage: The can opener is in the drawer.

corkscrew.definition: A tool for removing a cork from a bottle.
corkscrew.exampleUsage: The corkscrew is stored in the drawer.

plate.definition: A usually flat dish used for serving food.
plate.exampleUsage: The plate is on the table.

bowl.definition: A round open container with deep sides.

mug.definition: A drinking cup, usually with a handle and fairly deep sides.
mug.exampleUsage: The mug is beside the kettle.

glass.definition: A drinking vessel made of glass in this context.

cup.definition: A small drinking vessel, often with a handle.
cup.exampleUsage: The cup is on the saucer.

saucer.definition: A small dish placed under a cup.
saucer.exampleUsage: The saucer is under the cup.

cutting-board.definition: A board used as a surface for cutting food.

colander.definition: A bowl with holes used to drain food.
colander.exampleUsage: The colander is beside the sink.

measuring-cup.definition: A cup used to measure ingredients by volume.
measuring-cup.exampleUsage: The measuring cup is in the cupboard.

measuring-spoon.definition: A spoon used to measure a set volume of an ingredient.
measuring-spoon.exampleUsage: The measuring spoon is beside the flour.

mixing-bowl.definition: A bowl used for combining ingredients.
mixing-bowl.exampleUsage: The mixing bowl is on the counter.

pitcher.definition: A container with a handle and spout for pouring liquids.

dish-towel.definition: A cloth used for drying dishes.
dish-towel.exampleUsage: The dish towel hangs on a hook.

oven-mitt.definition: A padded glove used to handle hot cookware.
oven-mitt.exampleUsage: The oven mitt is beside the cooled tray.

apron.definition: A garment worn over clothes to protect them while working.
apron.exampleUsage: Tarek wears an apron in the kitchen.

trash-can.exampleUsage: Food scraps are in the trash can.

paper-towel.definition: Absorbent disposable paper used for wiping or drying.
paper-towel.exampleUsage: A paper towel is beside the sink.

plastic-wrap.definition: Thin food-wrapping plastic film, also called cling film.

aluminum-foil.definition: Thin sheets of aluminium used for wrapping or covering food.
aluminum-foil.exampleUsage: The aluminum foil roll is closed.

food-container.definition: A container used to hold or store food.
food-container.exampleUsage: The food container has a lid.

sponge.definition: An absorbent material used for washing or wiping.
sponge.exampleUsage: The sponge is beside the sink.

dish-soap.definition: A detergent used for washing dishes by hand.
dish-soap.exampleUsage: The dish soap bottle is closed.

dish-rack.definition: A stand where washed dishes drain and dry.
dish-rack.exampleUsage: The plates are in the dish rack.

cling-film.definition: Thin plastic food wrap; the British term for plastic wrap.
cling-film.exampleUsage: The cling film covers the bowl.

bread.definition: A baked food usually made from flour and water.

butter.definition: A dairy food made by churning cream.
butter.exampleUsage: The butter is in the refrigerator.

milk.definition: A liquid dairy food in this kitchen context.
milk.exampleUsage: The milk container is in the refrigerator.

egg.definition: An egg used as food in this context.
egg.exampleUsage: The egg is in the carton.

cheese.definition: A food made from coagulated milk.

rice.definition: Small cereal grains used as food.
rice.exampleUsage: Rice is cooking in the pot.

pasta.definition: Food made from dough, often shaped and dried before cooking.

cooking-oil.definition: Edible oil used to prepare food.
cooking-oil.exampleUsage: The cooking oil bottle is closed.

salt.definition: A mineral used to season food.
salt.exampleUsage: A small bowl of salt is on the counter.

sugar.definition: A sweet substance used in food and drinks.

pepper.definition: A spice made from peppercorns in this context.
pepper.exampleUsage: The pepper mill is on the table.

flour.definition: Powder made by grinding grain or other ingredients.
flour.exampleUsage: Flour is in a sealed bag.

vinegar.definition: A sour liquid used for flavouring food.
vinegar.exampleUsage: The vinegar bottle is in the cupboard.

honey.definition: A sweet substance made by bees.

apple.definition: A round fruit that grows on an apple tree.
apple.exampleUsage: An apple is on the counter.

juice.definition: Liquid from fruit or vegetables used as a drink.
